title: The Portrait of Windrow House
author: Felix Vane
blurb: Oscar Voss, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
